name: Higashimatsushima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Higashimatsushima city emblem in blue, red and green: a blue stylised human figure with a red head and green strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Higashimatsushima, a city in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 October 2007; the emblem dates from 28 July 2005.

features.role: Higashimatsushima city emblem — a blue stylised human figure with a red head and green strokes
